text: Authentic Brands Group completed its acquisition of Boardriders, the action-sports company owner of Quiksilver, Billabong, RVCA, Element and DC Shoes, on 1 September 2023.
short: Authentic Brands Group completed its acquisition of Boardriders (Quiksilver's owner)

source.name: FashionNetwork, 'Authentic Brands Group completes acquisition of Boardriders' (Olivier Guyot)
source.quote: After initiating the purchase of Boardriders in early spring, the American giant Authentic Brands Group officially announced the completion of the operation on September 1
